description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the domain layer, modeling articles with properties such as title, description, author, comments, and tags, along with computed properties for favorites and tag list.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with metadata, author, comments, and associated tags and favorites.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of favorites of the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Returns a list of tags associated with the article.
